title: Quiet money (batch 13): quiet biometric & digital-ID / age-verification vendor fortunes
source: Public record: company histories; CLEAR (Alclear, NYSE:YOU) filings; ID.me federal/state contracts + facial-recognition controversy; Persona/Founders Fund coverage; Entrust-Onfido 2024 acquisition; Socure. Catalog layer (#242 batch 13). Structural overlay; person nodes carry dossiers. FOCUS: the low-profile fortunes selling the biometric + identity/age-verification plumbing that the map's Digital-ID thread documents - the vendors who profit from identity-gating. HONESTY: ownership/contracts/products = fact; the surveillance-by-construction + efficacy critiques are the project's labeled position (see age-verification-abolition), NOT an endorsement of any 'better mechanism'; no cabal imputed.

edges.notes: Caryn Seidman-Becker co-founded + runs CLEAR (Alclear; NYSE: YOU) - biometric identity lanes at airports + venues (~30M+ members), now expanding into general identity, age, and healthcare verification; a low-profile founder-CEO fortune (fact).

CLEAR enrolls face/iris/fingerprint for tens of millions - one of the largest private consumer biometric databases; the honeypot-concentration concern the map's identity thread flags (fact of scale; risk framing = labeled position).
CLEAR is pushing from airport lanes into general digital-identity + age-verification - a private biometric ID expanding across everyday gating (fact of expansion).
Blake Hall founded ID.me - identity-proofing for US federal + state agencies (IRS, VA, unemployment); a quiet govtech identity fortune (fact).
ID.me holds identity-verification contracts across the IRS, VA, SSA, and state unemployment systems - private identity proofing embedded in government access (fact).

ID.me used facial recognition (initially effectively mandatory for IRS login) - after 2022 backlash it added a human-verification option + walked back some claims about its 1:many matching; the archetypal 'convenience vs surveillance' fight in gov identity (fact; efficacy/claims contested).

Persona (Founders Fund/Thiel-network backed) is an identity + age-verification vendor; the age-verification-abolition block flags such pipelines as combining ID capture, watchlist screening, and biometric retention - identity-gating as a data pipeline (fact of product category; the surveillance framing is the project's labeled position).

Persona sits in the Founders Fund / Thiel investment network - the same PayPal-mafia capital that also backs Palantir + surveillance-adjacent identity infrastructure (fact of backing; network framing graded).
Socure is a large identity-verification + fraud-scoring vendor to banks, fintechs, and government - predictive identity analytics feeding the KYC/onboarding layer (fact).

Entrust acquired Onfido (2024) - consolidating AI document + biometric identity/age-assurance into a larger security vendor; part of the age-assurance market roll-up ahead of UK OSA / EU rules (fact).
Onfido provides AI-based document + selfie biometric identity/age verification - a core supplier to the age-gating regimes (UK Online Safety Act, EU) the map tracks (fact).
